description_en: Creates an import task to import a DataWorks import and export package that contains objects such as data sources, tasks, and tables
description_zh: 调用CreateImportMigration接口创建导入任务，导入任务包含数据源信息、任务、表等对象的DataWorks导入导出包
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-import-migration --project-id 123456 --name test_import_001 --package-type DATAWORKS_MODEL --package-file /home/admin/xxx/import.zip --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateImportMigration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace Configuration page to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks管控台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the import task to be created. The name must be unique within the workspace
parameters.help_zh: 创建的导入任务的名称。项目空间内该名称必须唯一
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the import and export package. Valid values:
DATAWORKS_MODEL: standard format
DATAWORKS_V2: Apsara Stack (V3.6.1 to V3.11)
DATAWORKS_V3: Apsara Stack (V3.12 and later)
parameters.help_zh:
导入导出包的类型，取值如下：
DATAWORKS_MODEL（标准格式）
DATAWORKS_V2（专有云（V3.6.1-V3.11））
DATAWORKS_V3（专有云（V3.12及以上））
parameters.name: package_type
package_file
resource_group_map

parameters.help_en: The mapping used to change the input and output workspace names in the import and export package to the mapped workspace names during import and export operations. For example, during an import, the prefixes of the input and output workspace names are replaced based on the mapping
parameters.help_zh: 用于在执行导入导出操作时，根据该映射关系，修改导入导出包里的输入输出项目空间名称为映射后的项目空间名称。例如，导入时会根据映射关系，把输入输出里的项目空间名称的前缀做相应替换
parameters.name: workspace_map

parameters.help_en: The mapping between the source compute engines and the destination compute engine instances in the import task. Compute engine types include ODPS, EMR, HADOOP_CDH, and HOLOGRES
parameters.help_zh:
导入任务中，导入的源计算引擎到导出的目标计算引擎实例的映射关系。
计算引擎的类型，包括ODPS、EMR、HADOOP_CDH、HOLOGRES等
parameters.name: calculate_engine_map

parameters.example: {     "resourceAutoCommit": false,     "resourceAutoDeploy": false,     "functionAutoCommit": false,     "functionAutoDeploy": false,     "tableAutoCommitToDev": false,     "tableAutoCommitToProd": false,     "ignoreLock": false,     "fileAutoCommit": false,     "fileAutoDeploy": false   }
parameters.help_en:
The rules for automatic submission and publishing of tasks during the import operation. The parameters are as follows:
resourceAutoCommit: Specifies whether to automatically submit resources. true: yes. false: no.
resourceAutoDeploy: Specifies whether to automatically publish resources. true: yes. false: no.
functionAutoCommit: Specifies whether to automatically submit functions. true: yes. false: no.
functionAutoDeploy: Specifies whether to automatically publish functions. true: yes. false: no.
tableAutoCommitToDev: Specifies whether to automatically submit tables to the development environment. true: yes. false: no.
tableAutoCommitToProd: Specifies whether to automatically submit tables to the production environment. true: yes. false: no.
ignoreLock: Specifies whether to automatically bypass locks. true: yes. false: no. If a task is locked by another user for editing, you can forcibly update the current task by choosing to bypass the lock.
fileAutoCommit: Specifies whether to automatically submit files. true: yes. false: no.
fileAutoDeploy: Specifies whether to automatically publish files. true: yes. false: no
parameters.help_zh:
执行导入操作时，设定的自动提交发布任务的规则。参数如下：
resourceAutoCommit：资源是否自动提交。true 表示是，false表示否。
resourceAutoDeploy：资源是否自动发布。true 表示是，false表示否。
functionAutoCommit：函数是否自动提交。true 表示是，false表示否。
functionAutoDeploy： 函数是否自动发布。true 表示是，false表示否。
tableAutoCommitToDev：表是否自动提交到开发环境。true 表示是，false表示否。
tableAutoCommitToProd：表是否自动提交到生产环境。true 表示是，false表示否。
ignoreLock：是否自动绕过锁定。true 表示是，false表示否。当任务被其他人编辑锁定时，如果选择绕过锁定，则可以强制更新当前任务。
fileAutoCommit：文件是否自动提交，true 表示是，false表示否。
fileAutoDeploy：文件是否自动发布，true 表示是，false表示否
parameters.name: commit_rule

parameters.help_en: The description of the import and export package
parameters.help_zh: 导入导出包的描述信息
parameters.name: description
